seeded_from: git history of data/movies/ (77 commits, oldest 2026-07-27)
seed_note: First-seen dates were not invented. Each id is stamped with the commit that first published it, so the New badge means what it says from the first run. An id with no history gets the current scan time, which is correct: this is the first time it has been seen.
note: When each movie was first published, kept outside the cards because every scan rebuilds those from their sources. Ordering the catalogue by this is what makes a newly added film visible; without it a 2026 release sorted alphabetically onto page 5.
